newsitem.title: BELGIUM: TENNIS-BECKER TO PLAY IN EC TOURNAMENT.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-BECKER TO PLAY IN EC TOURNAMENT.

text.p: Australian Open champion Boris Becker will play in next month's European Community Championship (ECC), organisers said on Thursday.
"This is our greatest satisfaction. He was the first one to register and didn't ask for anything," tournament director Georges Baudeweyns said.
The field of the $1.0 million tournament, famous for a diamond-encrusted golden trophy, also includes world number four Yevgeny Kafelnikov and defending champion Michael Stich.
Other entries in the February 17-23 tournament include Swedish world number nine Thomas Enqvist and number 11 Marcelo Rios of Chile.
Baudeweyns said several grand slam winners had expressed interest in the two remaining wild cardsb but stopped short of naming Wimbledon champion Richard Krajicek and world number one Pete Sampras.
"I'm not allowed to," he said when asked why he declined to name Krajicek and Sampras.
The Antwerp trophy, shaped like a racket, is the prize for anyone who wins the event three times in five years.
